# BRO

> BRO is a calm, private messaging app for conversations with the people who matter. It is available on Android and on the web.

BRO's public website is https://bro.omixsystems.store/. The landing page is the canonical overview of the product; the web app is served from the same site at /app/.

## Public pages

- [BRO landing page](https://bro.omixsystems.store/): Product overview, download links, and entry to the web app.
- [Web app](https://bro.omixsystems.store/app/): BRO messaging experience for web browsers.
- [Privacy policy](https://bro.omixsystems.store/legal/privacy.html)
- [Terms of service](https://bro.omixsystems.store/legal/terms.html)
- [Cookie policy](https://bro.omixsystems.store/legal/cookie.html)
- [All Android releases](https://github.com/marvel-254/chat-app/releases)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/marvel-254/chat-app)

## Product summary

BRO focuses on direct conversations rather than public feeds. Product features include real-time messaging, voice notes, presence, and a dark-first interface. The landing page offers Android APK downloads and a same-site link to the web app.
